##### Project general facts

Sea Glints Mansions is an exclusive collection of beachfront villas set within a secure gated community beside The Oberoi Beach Resort. Contemporary architecture with generous glazing, clean lines and open terraces frames uninterrupted views of the sea. Each mansion rises from a ground floor to a first floor and offers five bedrooms together with a maid's room, providing spacious accommodation for large families. Three separate entrances allow residents, guests and service staff to move through the home with complete privacy.

Residents enjoy direct access to a private beach with soft white sand and calm, clear waters. Every villa features its own private swimming pool and landscaped garden, creating a secluded resort-style setting for relaxation and entertaining. A shared common garden adds open green space within the gated community, while up to three enclosed parking spaces per villa and round-the-clock security provide comfort, convenience and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine refined finishes with practical, family-oriented layouts. Bright living and dining areas open onto terraces and the pool deck, blending indoor and outdoor living. Branded kitchens are fitted with premium appliances, and bedroom suites offer generous wardrobes and elegant bathrooms. Homes are delivered with bespoke furniture in selected spaces together with fitted kitchens, giving owners a ready setting that can be completed with their own personal touches.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is an award-winning mixed-use coastal destination in Ajman, stretching along a white sandy beach, an inland creek and a protected mangrove forest that shelters a rich variety of birds and marine life. Landscaped gardens, cycling routes and meandering pathways run throughout the community, and the calm waters invite swimming, diving and snorkelling for much of the year.

The Oberoi Beach Resort sits right next to the villas, while the Nicklaus Design championship golf course, the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort and several marinas lie within the community. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai and both Sharjah and Dubai international airports, and Ajman City Centre, schools and hospitals are a short drive away, along with supermarkets, clinics and everyday services.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Large beachfront villas with private pools and direct beach access are in very limited supply, supporting demand from high-net-worth families and holiday home buyers. A mature resort lifestyle and accessible entry points compared with Dubai underpin long-term value.
